question: Should core permanently reserve the top-level `auth` CLI namespace for this shortcut even though plugins can own root CLI command descriptors?
rationale: This changes a public CLI/plugin ownership boundary; source review can identify the compatibility consequence but cannot decide whether maintainers intend to withdraw that namespace from plugins.

options.title: Keep Models Canonical
options.body: Retain `openclaw models auth list` as the sole supported surface and close or withdraw this alias proposal.

options.title: Reserve Auth For Core
options.body: Approve the namespace reservation and require collision behavior, upgrade documentation, compatibility tests, and live proof before merge.

options.title: Design Composable Aliases
options.body: Add an explicit plugin-compatible command composition or alias contract before reconsidering this shortcut.

recommendation.title: Keep Models Canonical
recommendation.body: Retain `openclaw models auth list` as the sole supported surface and close or withdraw this alias proposal.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the clearest current-history owner of the canonical model-auth listing behavior and are already connected to this PR timeline.
